guardrails.rationale: The prompt hook runs deterministic gate review on each user prompt and injects required Prism context without claiming prompt blocking as task intake.
Old-disease language is evaluated by the prompt gate before a turn proceeds.
Completion-claim language is routed through the prompt gate; explicit completion metadata remains CLI-enforced.
Diagnostic-only progress claims are evaluated at prompt time and remain hard-gated in CLI intake.
The prompt hook routes RedCap self-development through lifecycle checking, and lifecycle checking blocks unresolved Prism concern or block merges before implementation can proceed.
The prompt hook runs Prism gate, and Prism gate requires lifecycle packets for medium-or-higher RedCap self-development work.
UserPromptSubmit is a real Codex project hook with a gate-evaluation record in the Prism ledger.
SessionStart attempts a real Cap soul load and records the result in the live marker; redcap check also verifies the loader.
SessionStart is a real Codex project hook with a live-marker probe.
UserPromptSubmit is a real Codex project hook with a gate-decision live marker.
PreToolUse is a real Codex project hook that blocks known destructive commands and claims mutating session ownership.
PostToolUse is a real Codex project hook that records supported tool-use fingerprints for explicit closeout checks.
PostToolUse records action evidence automatically, and Stop runs the same-turn correlation check before closeout. The explicit command remains available for focused diagnostics.
Hook coverage validation remains required through runtime/bin/redcap hook-coverage-check and runtime/bin/redcap check; it is intentionally outside the Stop hot path.
Directory layout validation remains required through runtime/bin/redcap layout-check and runtime/bin/redcap check; it is intentionally outside the Stop hot path.
Session ownership checks remain required through runtime/bin/redcap session-ownership self-check and runtime/bin/redcap check; Stop keeps only closeout guards in its hot path.
FSM validation remains required through runtime/bin/redcap fsm check and runtime/bin/redcap check; it is intentionally outside the Stop hot path.
Knowledge gateway validation remains required through runtime/bin/redcap knowledge-gateway check and runtime/bin/redcap check; it is intentionally outside the Stop hot path.
Stop lints the final assistant reply for Chinese-first, human-readable output before closeout; file-level lint commands remain available for focused diagnostics.
Runtime boundary validation remains required through runtime/bin/redcap boundary check and runtime/bin/redcap check; it is intentionally outside the Stop hot path.
Stop runs runtime/bin/redcap check before closeout and also blocks unsupported 360-degree scan conclusions.
Stop runs the final-claim guard before closeout and blocks unsupported completion claims with advisory constraints.
Provider follow-up continuity remains enforced by the Prism dispatcher and verified through runtime/bin/redcap check; it is intentionally outside the Stop hot path.
The provider dispatcher self-check remains part of runtime/bin/redcap check and host-hook-audit; it is intentionally outside the Stop hot path.
Host hook capability is audited by runtime/bin/redcap host-hook-audit and runtime/bin/redcap check; unsupported provider-host hooks are reported as audit facts instead of fake parity.

Stop is redeployed as an advisory closeout review: it blocks closeout only to provide original-task-anchored correction constraints, and its self-check proves the old answer-drift pattern is not restored.

future_hook_policy.reason: Any future capability marked hook-required must name a required event, a deployed Codex hook, an operational matrix hook entry, and a live-marker probe before RedCap check can pass. Capabilities intentionally moved out of hook coverage must be marked explicit_command_required instead of pretending to be automatic.
